plan: The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid your value. This is because, for any bid from others, bidding your value either guarantees you win and make a profit (if your value is higher than the second-highest bid) or guarantees you don't overpay (if you lose to a higher bid). Since this is round 1 of 1, there's no history to learn from. Therefore, I will strictly adhere to the dominant strategy.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you want to win if and only if your value is greater than the second-highest bid. Bidding less than your value risks losing the auction to someone who values the item more, while bidding more than your value risks overpaying. Since this is a single round, I'll strictly adhere to this strategy.
